scope: Only the two agent-fixable review findings: near-opposite ray matrices and exposed mutable hit-test brand/state maps.
fixes: Ray matrices use a unit rotation axis and atan2(sine, cosine), including when cosine rounds to an endpoint. Matrix regeneration uses the same retained geometry.

Hit-test maps are closure-private. Shared allocation constructors initialize their new objects with validated backing interfaces and immutable records; shared map readers have no registration or mutation operations. Source activity derives from session membership instead of a writable retained flag.

validation.result: 54 packages installed; audit reported no vulnerabilities
typecheck, emitted build, browser bundles and Firefox package

historical_local_failures.result: Initial allocation-factory return inference introduced a TypeScript circular dependency. Explicit return/record types corrected it before the final build; no runtime assertion failed.

requirement_changes: None. Existing pinned specifications and acceptance remain unchanged.
instrumentation: Existing genuine extension/panel drivers and pinned WPT ray bodies. New page-side assertions inspect registry reader facets and attempt brand-copy/retained-record writes. The Android application observer inspects real transient groups without changing application requests, results, exceptions, rendering or input routes.
not_rerun: The other six application/browser/profile combinations and unrelated regressions were not rerun for these two findings. Prior eight-combination execution evidence remains historical and separate.
